column1: # The first two lines are RFC 9380 K.1 test vectors (asserted); the rest are produced by the halo2curves 0.9.0 function (copied verbatim into this crate).
# DST is the full DST bytes (nova uses "from_uniform_bytes" || "pallas:SHA-256_SVDW_RO_" etc.).
# uniform = expand_message_xmd_sha256(msg, DST, 96); u0 = Base::from_uniform_bytes(reverse(uniform[0..48])), u1 likewise on uniform[48..96] (each 48-byte chunk is read big-endian)
# Q0 = svdw_map_to_curve(u0), Q1 = svdw_map_to_curve(u1) (RFC 9380 6.6.1 Shallue-van de Woestijne, Z = -13, g(x)=x^3+5), result = Q0 + Q1 (cofactor 1)
# svdw_const <curve> z c1 c2 c3 c4 : precomputed SvdW constants (RFC 9380 F.1), c3 normalised to even sgn0.
# Field elements 64 hex (32 B LE). Points `x:y` affine. Base field of pallas = fp, of vesta = fq.
